title: The Impact of Hearing Loss on Young Children

phrases.def: 功能性自闭自闭谱谱谱系障碍

sentences.en: A Hearing impairment or other auditory function deficit in young children can have a major impact on their development of speech and communication, resulting in a detrimental effect on their ability to learn at school.
sentences.zh: 幼儿听力障碍或其他听力功能缺陷会严重影响其言语和交流的发展,对其在学校学习的能力产生不利影响。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This is likely to have major consequences for the individual and the population as a whole.
sentences.zh: 这很可能对个人和整个人口产生严重后果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The New Zealand Ministry of Health has found from research carried out over two decades that 6-10% of children in that country are affected by hearing loss.
sentences.zh: 新西兰卫生部从20多年来进行的研究中发现,该国有6%-10%的儿童听力受损。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: B A preliminary study in New Zealand has shown that classroom noise presents a major concern for teachers and pupils.
sentences.zh: B 新西兰的一项初步研究表明,教室噪音是教师和学生主要关注的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Modern teaching practices, the organisation of desks in the classroom, poor classroom acoustics, and mechanical means of ventilation such as air-conditioning units all contribute to the number of children unable to comprehend the teacher’s voice.
sentences.zh: 现代教学实践、课堂办公桌的设置、教室声音差、以及空调设备等通风机械工具,都增加了无法理解教师声音的儿童人数。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Education researchers Nelson and Soli have also suggested that recent trends in learning often involve collaborative interaction of multiple minds and tools as much as individual possession of information.
sentences.zh: 教育研究人员纳尔逊和索利也指出,最近的学习趋势往往涉及多种思想和工具的协作互动,以及个人拥有的信息。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This all amounts to heightened activity and noise levels, which have the potential to be particularly serious for children experiencing auditory function deficit.
sentences.zh: 这都相当于活动增加和噪音增加,对听觉功能不足的儿童而言,这可能特别严重。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Noise in classrooms can only exacerbate their difficulty in comprehending and processing verbal communication with other children and instructions from the teacher.
sentences.zh: 教室中的噪音只会加重他们理解和处理与其他儿童的口头交流以及教师的指示的困难。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C Children with auditory function deficit are potentially failing to learn to their maximum potential because of noise levels generated in classrooms.
sentences.zh: C类听力功能不足的儿童由于教室噪音的噪音,可能无法学习到最大的潜力。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The effects of noise on the ability of children to learn effectively in typical classroom environments are now the subject of increasing concern.
sentences.zh: 噪音对儿童在典型课堂环境中有效学习的能力的影响,现在日益引起人们的关注。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The International Institute of Noise Control Engineering (l-INCE), on the advice of the World Health Organization, has established an international working party, which includes New Zealand, to evaluate noise and reverberation control for school rooms.
sentences.zh: 国际噪音控制工程研究所(I-INCE)根据世界卫生组织的建议,成立了一个国际工作组,其中包括新西兰,负责评估校舍的噪音和回响控制。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D While the detrimental effects of noise in classroom situations are not limited to children experiencing disability, those with a disability that affects their processing of speech and verbal communication could be extremely vulnerable.
sentences.zh: D. 虽然课堂上噪音的有害影响不仅限于残疾儿童,但影响其语言和语言交流的残疾儿童可能极其脆弱。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The auditory function deficits in question include hearing impairment, autistic spectrum disorders (ASD) and attention deficit disorders (ADD/ADHD).
sentences.zh: 有关的听力功能缺陷包括听障、自闭症谱系障碍和注意力缺失症(ADD/ADHD)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: E Autism is considered a neurological and genetic life-long disorder that causes discrepancies in the way information is processed.
sentences.zh: 自闭症被认为是一种神经和遗传终身障碍,造成信息处理方式的差异。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This disorder is characterised by interlinking problems with social imagination, social communication and social interaction.
sentences.zh: 这种混乱的特点是,问题与社会想象力、社会交流和社会互动相互关联。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: According to Janzen, this affects the ability to understand and relate in typical ways to people, understand events and objects in the environment, and understand or respond to sensory stimuli.
sentences.zh: Janzen认为,这影响到人们以典型方式理解和与人沟通、了解环境事件和物体、了解或应对感官刺激的能力。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Autism does not allow learning or thinking in the same ways as in children who are developing normally.
sentences.zh: 自闭症不允许以与正常发育的儿童相同的方式学习或思考。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Autistic spectrum disorders often result in major difficulties in comprehending verbal information and speech processing.
sentences.zh: 听力障碍症往往在理解口头信息和语言处理方面造成重大困难。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Those experiencing these disorders often find sounds such as crowd noise and the noise generated by machinery painful and distressing.
sentences.zh: 患有这些障碍的人往往会发现人群噪音和机器产生的噪音等声音,令人痛苦和痛苦。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This is difficult to scientifically quantify as such extra-sensory stimuli vary greatly from one autistic individual to another.
sentences.zh: 由于这种超感官刺激因素因自闭症个体和个体之间差异很大,因此难以从科学上加以量化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But a child who finds any type of noise in their classroom or learning space intrusive is likely to be adversely affected in their ability to process information.
sentences.zh: 但是,在课堂或学习空间侵入中发现任何类型的噪音的儿童,在处理信息的能力方面,很可能受到不利影响。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F The attention deficit disorders are indicative of neurological and genetic disorders and are characterised by difficulties with sustaining attention, effort and persistence, organisation skills and disinhibition.
sentences.zh: F 注意力缺失症表明神经和遗传疾病,其特点是难以保持注意力、努力和持久性、组织技能和消除残疾。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Children experiencing these disorders find it difficult to screen out unimportant information, and focus on everything in the environment rather than attending to a single activity.
sentences.zh: 患有这些失调症的儿童发现很难筛选出不重要的信息,并把重点放在环境的一切方面,而不是只从事一项活动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Background noise in the classroom becomes a major distraction, which can affect their ability to concentrate.
sentences.zh: 教室里的背景噪音成为一大干扰,可能影响他们的集中能力。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: G Children experiencing an auditory function deficit can often find speech and communication very difficult to isolate and process when set against high levels of background noise.
sentences.zh: G 听力功能不足的儿童往往会发现,在面对高度背景噪音时,很难孤立和处理语言和沟通。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: These levels come from outside activities that penetrate the classroom structure, from teaching activities, and other noise generated inside, which can be exacerbated by room reverberation.
sentences.zh: 这些水平来自渗透教室结构的外部活动、教学活动以及室内产生的其它噪音,而房间反响可能加剧这些噪音。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Strategies are needed to obtain the optimum classroom construction and perhaps a change in classroom culture and methods of teaching.
sentences.zh: 需要制定战略,以取得最佳教室建设,或许改变教室文化和教学方法。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In particular, the effects of noisy classrooms and activities on those experiencing disabilities in the form of auditory function deficit need thorough investigation.
sentences.zh: 特别是,需要彻底调查吵闹的教室和活动对听力功能不足的残疾人的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is probable that many undiagnosed children exist in the education system with ‘invisible’ disabilities.
sentences.zh: 教育系统中很可能有许多未诊断出患有 " 隐形 " 残疾的儿童。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Their needs are less likely to be met than those of children with known disabilities.
sentences.zh: 与已知残疾儿童相比,他们的需求不太可能得到满足。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: H The New Zealand Government has developed a New Zealand Disability Strategy and has embarked on a wide-ranging consultation process.
sentences.zh: H 新西兰政府制定了新西兰残疾人战略,并开始了广泛的协商进程。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The strategy recognises that people experiencing disability face significant barriers in achieving a full quality of life in areas such as attitude, education, employment and access to services.
sentences.zh: 该战略承认,残疾人在态度、教育、就业和获得服务等领域实现充分生活质量面临重大障碍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 战略战略战略战略战略

sentences.en: Objective 3 of the New Zealand Disability Strategy is to ‘Provide the Best Education for Disabled People’ by improving education so that all children, youth learners and adult learners will have equal opportunities to learn and develop within their already existing local school.
sentences.zh: 新西兰残疾战略的目标3是 " 为残疾人提供最佳教育 ",改善教育,使所有儿童、青年学习者和成人学习者都有平等机会在其现有的当地学校内学习和发展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For a successful education, the learning environment is vitally significant, so any effort to improve this is likely to be of great benefit to all children, but especially to those with auditory function disabilities.
sentences.zh: 要想成功教育,学习环境至关重要,因此,任何改善学习环境的努力都可能对所有儿童,特别是听力功能残疾的儿童,产生极大好处。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: I A number of countries are already in the process of formulating their own standards for the control and reduction of classroom noise.
sentences.zh: 我一些国家已经在制订自己的控制和减少教室噪音的标准。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: New Zealand will probably follow their example.
sentences.zh: 新西兰可能将效仿它们的做法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The literature to date on noise in school rooms appears to focus on the effects on schoolchildren in general, their teachers and the hearing impaired.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止,关于校舍噪音的文献似乎侧重于对一般学童、他们的教师和听力受损者的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Only limited attention appears to have been given to those students experiencing the other disabilities involving auditory function deficit.
sentences.zh: 似乎只对患有其他残疾的学生给予有限的关注,这些学生患有其他残疾,包括听力功能缺陷。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is imperative that the needs of these children are taken into account in the setting of appropriate international standards to be promulgated in future.
sentences.zh: 在制定今后颁布的适当国际标准时,必须考虑到这些儿童的需要。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
